Help

What is Linn Game Store?
Linn Game Store has been Myanmar's fast, safe and reliable platform for game top-ups and in-game currency (Diamonds, UC, and more) since 2026. It comes with a Wallet, VIP tiers, and a direct Telegram line to the admin.
How do I place an order?
Pick a game from the Home page. Choose a Package/Currency and enter your In-Game ID (and Server ID if needed). Tap "Confirm ID" to verify it's correct. Finally, choose a payment type and confirm.
How do I pay?
You can pay directly from your Wallet balance, or choose a Payment Method and upload a transfer receipt. To top up your Wallet, use "Top Up" on the Wallet page.
How do I check my order status?
On the History page, each order shows live Pending → Processing → Success/Fail status. If it stays in Processing too long, reach out via the "Ticket" tab.
How do I get help if there's a problem?
For details, use the "Ticket" tab (logged as a ticket). To talk directly, tap the "Telegram" tab to message the admin.
How do I get started the very first time?
The first time you open the app, it asks you to sign in with your Google account - just pick your Gmail account, no password to type. Then choose a language (Myanmar / English); you can switch it later from "Language" in the Drawer menu. Tap "Get Started" to reach the Home page. Along the bottom you'll see 4 tabs - "Top Up" (buy game Diamonds/UC), "Voucher" (gift cards), "Wallet" (your balance), and "Profile" (your info). There's also a menu icon at the top-left that opens the Drawer, with History, Name Check, Leaderboard, Support and more.
Placing an order - a full step-by-step guide
1) On the Home page ("Top Up" tab), scroll to the game you want and tap it. 2) On the game's page, choose a Package/Currency (e.g. how many Diamonds). 3) In the "In-Game ID" field, enter your Player ID (some games also need a Server ID) - you can find this on your profile inside the game. 4) Tap "Confirm ID" - the system automatically shows your account name; double-check it's correct (re-enter the ID if the name looks wrong). 5) Choose a payment type - pay instantly from your Wallet balance if you have enough, or pick a Payment Method (bank transfer, KBZPay, Wave, etc.) and upload a photo of your transfer receipt. 6) Drag the slide button at the bottom to confirm and your order is placed. 7) Track its status any time under "History" in the Drawer menu.
How to top up your Wallet - in detail
1) Tap "Wallet" in the bottom tabs. 2) Tap "Top Up". 3) Enter the amount you want to add. 4) Choose a Payment Method (bank transfer, Crypto, FazerCard, etc.) - the account details to send money to will appear based on what you pick. 5) After transferring outside the app, upload a photo of the receipt or the transaction ID and tap Submit. 6) Once an admin verifies it, the money is added to your Wallet automatically (usually within a few minutes to a few hours). From then on, you can pay for orders instantly from your Wallet balance without uploading a receipt each time.
Checking Order History, and what to do if there's a problem
Open the Drawer from the top-left menu icon and choose "History". You can see each order's status here - "Pending", "Processing", "Success" or "Fail". Tap an order to see its details such as ID, amount and time. If Processing takes too long, or you run into any other issue, use the "Ticket" tab in the Support widget - the admin logs it as a ticket and gets back to you. For a faster, direct line, use the "Telegram" tab instead.
What else can I do in the app?
"Voucher" tab - buy gift cards and top-up vouchers instantly. "Name Check" in the Drawer - check whether a game ID is valid before placing an order. "Leaderboard" - see the top spenders. Your "Profile" shows your VIP tier and total spend. Theme (Dark/Light Mode) and language can also be changed from the Drawer.
How do I contact the admin?
Tap the button below (or the "Admin" tab) to chat with the admin on Telegram. For an order problem, first send a Ticket so it is logged, then message the admin with your Order ID from the History page. The admin will never ask for your password or login code.
Which Telegram bot should I use?
Our official customer bot is @linngamestorebot. Open it and tap Start (/start) once - without this the bot cannot message you. You then get a menu with your Wallet, Top Up, My Orders and Help Center, and the bot sends your order updates. To talk to a person, use "Message Admin" above. Never send money, passwords or codes to any other bot or account.Open @linngamestorebot
What is a Ticket? Use a Ticket to report a problem with an order, top-up or payment (for example an order stuck in Processing, or an error message). Describe what happened and attach a screenshot of the error if you can - it helps the admin fix it faster. For a quick chat, use the Telegram tab instead.

Terms & Policy

About This Service
Linn Game Store (operating at linngamestore.com) is a game top-up and voucher store. By using this site, browsing, creating an account, or placing an order, you agree to these Terms.
Orders & Delivery
Orders are processed automatically once payment is confirmed. Delivery time depends on the game/voucher provider and is usually instant to a few minutes; some orders may need manual admin review.
Payments
We accept manual payment methods (Kpay/Wave/etc. with receipt upload), Wallet balance, and Crypto/USDT top-up. Payments must use accurate details. Orders placed with incorrect In-Game ID, Server ID, or payment proof may be delayed or rejected — see the Refund tab for what happens in that case.
Account & Wallet
You're responsible for keeping your account details accurate. Wallet balance is tied to your account/guest ID, is non-transferable between accounts, and can only be used for purchases on this store.
Fair Use
Abuse of promotions, chargebacks, or fraudulent payment proof may lead to an order being cancelled or an account being restricted.
Changes to These Terms
We may update these Terms as the store evolves. Continued use after an update means you accept the revised Terms.
Contact
Questions about these terms? Reach us via Telegram @linn270_0 or the Support button on your Profile page.
What We Collect
A device/guest ID to identify your account, profile info you choose to add (name, phone number), your Google name/photo if you sign in with Google, the In-Game ID/Server ID you enter per order, payment receipt images for manual top-ups, and your order/wallet top-up history.
Why We Collect It
Solely to process your orders and top-ups, verify payments, deliver in-game items to the correct account, run the wallet system, and respond to support requests. We don't use your data for advertising.
How Long We Keep It
Completed order and wallet top-up records (Success/Fail or Completed/Rejected) are automatically deleted after 7 days. Pending/Processing orders are kept until resolved. Your profile info (name, phone, wallet balance) is kept for as long as your account/guest ID is active.
Sharing
We don't sell your personal data. Payment receipts and top-up details are only used internally to confirm your payment; crypto top-ups are verified on the public blockchain network you send to.
Access & Deletion
You can message Telegram @linn270_0 at any time to ask what data we hold about you or to request deletion of your profile and history, unless we need to keep specific records to resolve an open order/payment dispute.
Children
This store is not directed at young children. If you are under the age required by your country's law to make online payments without a guardian, please only use this service with a parent/guardian's involvement.
Changes to This Policy
We may update this Privacy Policy as the store evolves. Continued use after an update means you accept the revised Policy.
Contact
Privacy questions? Reach us via Telegram @linn270_0.
Successful Orders
Once an order is marked Success and the item is delivered, it is final and non-refundable — this includes cases where you entered the wrong In-Game ID or Server ID yourself, since digital delivery to that account can't be reversed. Please double-check your ID before confirming.
Failed Orders
If an order fails (e.g. the provider couldn't deliver it), we refund the order amount to your Wallet balance, typically within 24 hours of the order being marked Failed. You can then use that balance for another order.
Cancelling an Order
Orders still in Pending status can usually be cancelled by contacting Support. Once an order has moved to Processing (sent to the game/voucher provider), it can no longer be cancelled.
Manual Top-Ups (Kpay/Wave/etc.)
If a manual top-up request is rejected (e.g. unclear or invalid receipt), no Wallet balance is credited — since the money never passed through our Wallet system, please keep your own payment app's transaction record and contact Support if you believe the rejection was a mistake.
Crypto/USDT Top-Ups
Blockchain transactions are irreversible. Please confirm you're sending the correct amount on the correct network shown in the app. We can't recover funds sent to the wrong address, wrong network, or wrong amount.
Wallet Balance
Wallet balance can only be used for purchases on this store and isn't redeemable for cash or transferable to another account, except where we choose to resolve a specific issue that way.
How to Raise a Dispute
Contact Telegram @linn270_0 with your Order ID or Top-Up ID as soon as possible — ideally within 7 days, since order/top-up history older than 7 days is automatically deleted from our records.
